content.text: If you're struggling to sell presets in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Pakistan due to Stripe's absence, you're not alone. With only 46 countries supported by Stripe, many creators are left without a reliable digital commerce platform. In reality, Stripe's limitations are just the tip of the iceberg. PayPal account suspensions can freeze your money for up to 180 days with no appeal, and Gumroad's restrictions leave many sellers scrambling for alternatives.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

When it comes to digital commerce, each option has its own set of features and limitations. Stripe, for example, offers a robust payment processing system, but its restricted country list is a major drawback. PayPal, on the other hand, provides a more flexible payment system, but its account suspension policies can be devastating to sellers. Gumroad is another popular option, but its restrictions on certain countries and payment methods make it less than ideal for many creators. NOWPayments, a [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-3|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|crypto]]currency payment processor, offers a more decentralized and borderless approach, but its fees and user experience can be a challenge for some sellers.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries are a significant concern for digital sellers. Stripe's limited country list means that many sellers are unable to access its services, while PayPal's account suspension policies can freeze funds in countries where it operates. Gumroad's restrictions on certain countries and payment methods make it less than ideal for sellers in these areas. NOWPayments, on the other hand, operates in over 300 cryptocurrencies and has no country restrictions, making it a more viable option for sellers in restricted areas.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical considerations for digital sellers. Stripe's payment processing fees can range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 3.4% + 30¢, depending on the country and payment method. PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 4.4% + 30¢, depending on the transaction type and currency. Gumroad's fees range from 3.5% + 30¢ to 8% + 30¢, depending on the payment method and seller's country. NOWPayments' fees range from 0.5% + 25¢ to 1% + 25¢, depending on the cryptocurrency and payment method.
Stripe's limited country list and PayPal's account suspension policies can be devastating to sellers in restricted countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of a robust digital commerce platform. Stripe and PayPal provide some level of automation, but sellers may still need to manually manage orders and delivery. Gumroad's automation features are more advanced, but its restrictions on certain payment methods and countries can be a challenge. NOWPayments' automation features are highly customizable, allowing sellers to automate delivery and payment processing with ease.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-3|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] for your digital commerce platform depends on your specific needs and limitations. If you're in a restricted country, NOWPayments may be the best option due to its decentralized and borderless approach. If you're looking for a more robust payment processing system, Stripe or PayPal may be a better choice. However, if you're looking for a more advanced automation feature and customization options, Gumroad or NOWPayments may be the way to go.
